opportunities.title: Small grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together, covering arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Supports festivals, workshops, exchanges, collaborative projects, teaching, academic research and visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record, but practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields are also considered. Preference is given to those not previously involved in UK‑Japan collaboration and to early‑career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants can fund travel, conference and publication costs for collaborative projects lasting up to three years.
